career_ladder.note: National Investigation Agency (NIA) under the Ministry of Home Affairs recruits Sub-Inspectors through the Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level (SSC CGL) Examination and via deputation from Central Armed Police Forces and state police organizations. Executive personnel progress through standard central police officer hierarchies up to Superintendent of Police.

exam_scheme.note: Direct recruitment of Sub-Inspectors in the National Investigation Agency is conducted through the SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination. The examination comprises Tier-I (CBT with 100 questions carrying 200 marks in Reasoning, GA, Quantitative Aptitude, English; qualifying in nature) and Tier-II (Paper I with Section I: Mathematical Abilities & Reasoning 180 marks; Section II: English Comprehension & General Awareness 210 marks; Section III: Computer Knowledge 60 marks + Data Entry Speed Test). Final allocation requires meeting the prescribed physical standards and medical fitness criteria for NIA posts.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Sectional cut-off; combined with Section II for final merit ranking

papers.paper_name: Session II: English Language & Comprehension (135) & General Awareness (75)
papers.negative_marking: -1 mark for each wrong answer (+3 for correct)

papers.paper_name: Session III: Computer Knowledge Test (60) & Data Entry Speed Test (DEST)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory qualifying pass and minimum typing speed of 2,000 key depressions

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspector in the National Investigation Agency is placed in central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 (entry basic ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400). A distinguishing financial benefit for NIA personnel is the Special Security Allowance (SSA) at 20% of basic pay (in addition to standard DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance) as well as cash compensation equivalent to 30 days basic pay per year in lieu of duties performed on non-working days / gazetted holidays.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NIA Recruitment Notice — Sub-Inspector Pay Level 6 + 20% Special Security Allowance
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹35,400 + 20% Special Security Allowance (₹7,080) + 58% DA (₹20,532) + HRA (10%-30%: ₹3,540 to ₹10,620) + Transport Allowance (₹2,844 to ₹5,688) yields gross ~₹69,000 to ~₹85,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and standard deductions.
official_perks: Special Security Allowance (SSA) of 20% of basic pay granted across all executive ranks in NIA
Cash compensation equivalent to 30 days basic pay (one additional month salary) per calendar year for round-the-clock operational duties
Government-funded residential quarters in Central Police Housing or full central HRA
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) comprehensive medical cover for self and dependents
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly central government matching contribution
Specialized tactical and cyber-investigation training opportunities at National Police Academy and international partner agencies
